items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: The interviewee only says 'Oh, I see why' in response to the interviewer mentioning Frankie Doosan. No personal interaction or relationship is described.

ctx.x: I do remember, yes. That was the band then. Because the trombone... I can't think of the name.
Do you remember there were a couple of trombonists that worked with Buddy Bolden, they tell me I didn't know them. Frankie Doosan. From Frankie Doosan, yes.
